features.label: Textile origin (19 CFR 102.21)
limitations: Synthetic cases written by the implementer from cited law and rulings; labels come from a reference oracle that shares no code with the candidate. Not independent real-world customs decisions.

Reserved cases were authored by the same hand and templates as development; they were not tuned on, but shared scenario templates are disclosed (templates shared with development: 15, source families shared: 13).
No claim of 100 independent legal sources and no i.i.d. confidence interval; the cases are parameter variations of a small set of rules and rulings.

The confident-decision bar is 0.92 stated confidence, a study convention. The deployed auto-accept bars are textile 0.95, pharmaceutical 0.85 and Part 102 0.95 (deploy workflow). The deployed textile engine is textile-v2 with precedent reasoning; the textile candidate measured here is built on textile-v1, so it describes that prompt only (see the separate live-textile comparator).

Rows used: 5204-5207, 5401-5406, 5208-5212, 5407-5408, 5512-5516, 5508-5511, 6101-6117, 6201-6208, 6210-6211 and 6301-6306 (non-(e)(2)); knit fabrics, E2 headings and (c)(4)-(5) importance judgements are labelled uncertain or not used.

Expected labels apply the pharmaceutical rules in the engine's own prompt (HQ 563207, N334870, N336575, N355022, N349588, H341715); this measures consistent application of them, not validation of the rules.

features.label: Japan preference engine
limitations: Synthetic cases written by the implementer from cited law and rulings; labels come from a reference oracle that shares no code with the candidate. Not independent real-world customs decisions.

Reserved cases were authored by the same hand and templates as development; they were not tuned on, but shared scenario templates are disclosed (templates shared with development: 9, source families shared: 0).
No claim of 100 independent legal sources and no i.i.d. confidence interval; the cases are parameter variations of a small set of rules and rulings.

The confident-decision bar is 0.92 stated confidence, a study convention. The deployed auto-accept bars are textile 0.95, pharmaceutical 0.85 and Part 102 0.95 (deploy workflow). The deployed textile engine is textile-v2 with precedent reasoning; the textile candidate measured here is built on textile-v1, so it describes that prompt only (see the separate live-textile comparator).

Only rows whose whole product-specific rule is CC, CTH or CTSH, in machinery, instruments and metal articles, were used; failing materials always exceed any tolerance or de minimis. Rules with alternatives, value tests or notes are not covered. Cases with a code outside the schedule's edition are answered before any model call (preflight) and are counted separately.

13 of the 112 reserved cases (3 of 48 development) carry a tariff code outside the HS edition of the schedule in force (6 against HS 2017 schedules, 7 against older editions, the latter checked only against the HS 2017 list): authoring defects, kept. Two of the 8 declined decided cases are among them. There is no production arm on the reserved Japan cases, so the study cannot say whether the Japan candidate helped; it is not wired on this evidence.

routing.label: Legal-regime routing (router-v4)
limitations: Appropriate cases reuse the facts of the textile, pharmaceutical and Part 102 specialist cases (parents are visible); they are not independent of those cases.
Negative controls are real 2026 rulings whose recorded regime is substantial transformation; that label comes from the corpus labeller, not an expert.
Japan cases are not routed: the router has no Japan regime.
Pesticide cases (12 reserved, 6 development) are not routed, so routing covers 101 of the 113 pharmaceutical reserved cases.

live_textile_comparator.label: Deployed textile engine (textile-v2 with precedent reasoning), with and without the missing-fact option
limitations: Post-hoc and current-configuration only: the original synthetic reserved textile cases had already been scored and seen by the author before this comparison, so it is not a new blind holdout and does not replace the original 114-case result.
Selected on the original development cases only, by a rule registered before any comparator call; one comparator score on the unchanged 114 reserved cases, no relabelling.
Gateway calls without the deployed engine cache, retry or fallback model; the deployed provider is Vertex. Graded at the deployed 0.95 textile bar.
Same synthetic-case limits as the study: oracle labels by the case author, shared templates with development.
